decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch within the firm’s core dumper line that still had its own product page in 2024, it appears to be meeting at least acceptable aspiration levels and fits the firm’s established capabilities and sales channels.

This articulated construction dumper remained prominently marketed through 2024 and is close to the firm’s established business, so boundedly rational management would likely retain it as a satisfactory extension of the core range.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the firm’s core offer and lost prominence from its own page in 2023 to only a mention in 2024 without any positive result signal, suggesting performance below aspiration and prompting reallocation of resources.

The compact telescopic loader stayed on its own page in 2024 and builds on existing product and service strengths, so it likely clears the firm’s aspiration threshold or is close enough to justify continued support.

The material lift is close to the existing offer and the reported large order for a long-popular model is a clear positive market signal, indicating results above aspiration and supporting continuation.

Although distant from the established offer, the underground mining loader shows strong early use with 1,000 operating hours in seven months, and with industry growth and some organizational slack the firm would likely keep it to exploit and learn from this promising result.
